chat_power_match_clock:
SELECT game_seq, MIN(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date,
       MIN(CASE WHEN game_time_epoch > 0 THEN game_time_epoch END) AS game_time_epoch
FROM hok.chat_battle_record_keys
GROUP BY game_seq
chat_battle_power_players:
WITH configured AS (
    SELECT participant.game_seq, participant.participant_index, MIN(player.player_key) AS player_key
    FROM hok.battle_power_players AS participant
    JOIN hok.chat_configured_players AS player
      ON (player.role_id = participant.role_id
          AND (player.user_id IS NULL OR participant.user_id IS NULL OR player.user_id = participant.user_id))
      OR (player.user_id = participant.user_id
          AND player.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM hok.chat_configured_users)
          AND (player.role_id IS NULL OR participant.role_id IS NULL))
    GROUP BY participant.game_seq, participant.participant_index
), tracked AS (
    SELECT game_seq, role_id, MIN(player_key) AS player_key
    FROM hok.chat_recorded_battle_source
    GROUP BY game_seq, role_id
)
SELECT power.game_seq,
       clock.snapshot_date,
       clock.game_time_epoch,
       (power.map_name ~ '(排位|巅峰|战队)' AND lower(coalesce(power.map_name, '')) !~ '(1v1|2v2|3v3)') AS is_official,
       COALESCE(configured.player_key, tracked.player_key) AS player_key,
       power.map_name,
       power.evaluated_at,
       own_team.is_bot_team AS participant_side_is_bot,
       rival_team.is_bot_team AS rival_side_is_bot,
       activity.previous_game_time_epoch,
       activity.game_time_epoch - activity.previous_game_time_epoch AS gap_since_previous_game_seconds,
       activity.record_source AS activity_record_source,
       activity.previous_game_record_source,
       CASE WHEN power.my_side_level > 0 AND power.opponent_side_level > 0
            THEN (power.my_side_level + power.opponent_side_level) / 2.0 END AS match_average_level,
       participant.participant_index,
       participant.nickname,
       participant.side,
       participant.hero_name,
       participant.hero_power,
       participant.hero_win_rate,
       participant.hero_average_score,
       participant.single_level,
       (participant.payload - ARRAY['roleId','userId','requestErrors','playerAvatarUrl','heroAvatarUrl']) || jsonb_build_object('requestErrorCount', CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(participant.payload->'requestErrors') = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(participant.payload->'requestErrors') END) AS participant_payload,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.my_side_level
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.opponent_side_level
       END AS participant_side_level,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.opponent_side_level
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.my_side_level
       END AS rival_side_level,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.my_side_tier
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.opponent_side_tier
       END AS participant_side_tier,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.opponent_side_tier
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.my_side_tier
       END AS rival_side_tier,
       CASE
           WHEN participant.side = 'my' THEN power.game_result
           WHEN participant.side = 'op' AND power.game_result = '胜利' THEN '失败'
           WHEN participant.side = 'op' AND power.game_result = '失败' THEN '胜利'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS participant_result
FROM hok.battle_power AS power
LEFT JOIN hok.chat_power_match_clock AS clock ON clock.game_seq = power.game_seq
JOIN hok.battle_power_players AS participant ON participant.game_seq = power.game_seq
LEFT JOIN tracked ON tracked.game_seq = participant.game_seq AND tracked.role_id = participant.role_id
LEFT JOIN configured ON configured.game_seq = participant.game_seq AND configured.participant_index = participant.participant_index
LEFT JOIN hok.chat_power_team_flags AS own_team ON own_team.game_seq = participant.game_seq AND own_team.side = participant.side
LEFT JOIN hok.chat_power_team_flags AS rival_team ON rival_team.game_seq = participant.game_seq AND rival_team.side = CASE participant.side WHEN 'my' THEN 'op' WHEN 'op' THEN 'my' END
LEFT JOIN hok.chat_power_activity AS activity ON activity.game_seq = participant.game_seq AND activity.player_key = COALESCE(configured.player_key, tracked.player_key)
chat_battle_power:
WITH players AS (
    SELECT game_seq,
           array_agg(DISTINCT player_key) FILTER (WHERE player_key IS NOT NULL) AS player_keys,
           jsonb_agg(participant_payload || jsonb_build_object('playerKey', player_key, 'participantIndex', participant_index)
                     ORDER BY participant_index) AS items
    FROM hok.chat_battle_power_players
    GROUP BY game_seq
)
SELECT power.game_seq, clock.snapshot_date, clock.game_time_epoch,
       power.map_name, (power.map_name ~ '(排位|巅峰|战队)' AND lower(coalesce(power.map_name, '')) !~ '(1v1|2v2|3v3)') AS is_official, power.evaluated_at,
       CASE WHEN power.my_side_level > 0 AND power.opponent_side_level > 0
            THEN (power.my_side_level + power.opponent_side_level) / 2.0 END AS match_average_level,
       my_team.is_bot_team AS my_side_is_bot,
       op_team.is_bot_team AS opponent_side_is_bot,
       COALESCE(players.player_keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS player_keys,
       (power.payload - ARRAY['gameSvrId','relaySvrId','roleid','players'])
       || CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(power.payload->'mySide') = 'object' THEN jsonb_build_object('mySide', ((power.payload->'mySide') - 'requestErrors') || jsonb_build_object('requestErrorCount', CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(power.payload->'mySide'->'requestErrors')='array' THEN jsonb_array_length(power.payload->'mySide'->'requestErrors') END)) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
       || CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(power.payload->'opSide') = 'object' THEN jsonb_build_object('opSide', ((power.payload->'opSide') - 'requestErrors') || jsonb_build_object('requestErrorCount', CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(power.payload->'opSide'->'requestErrors')='array' THEN jsonb_array_length(power.payload->'opSide'->'requestErrors') END)) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
       || CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(power.payload->'matchup') = 'object' THEN jsonb_build_object('matchup', (power.payload->'matchup') - 'error') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
       || jsonb_build_object('players', COALESCE(players.items, '[]'::jsonb)) AS payload
FROM hok.battle_power AS power
LEFT JOIN hok.chat_power_match_clock AS clock ON clock.game_seq = power.game_seq
LEFT JOIN players ON players.game_seq = power.game_seq
LEFT JOIN hok.chat_power_team_flags AS my_team ON my_team.game_seq = power.game_seq AND my_team.side = 'my'
LEFT JOIN hok.chat_power_team_flags AS op_team ON op_team.game_seq = power.game_seq AND op_team.side = 'op'
chat_power_team_flags:
SELECT participant.game_seq, participant.side,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 5
                  AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(participant.payload->>'isAuth') IN ('true','false','1','0')) = 5
            THEN BOOL_AND(lower(participant.payload->>'isAuth') IN ('false','0'))
                 AND CASE participant.side
                     WHEN 'my' THEN COALESCE(power.my_side_level, 0) = 0
                     WHEN 'op' THEN COALESCE(power.opponent_side_level, 0) = 0
                 END
       END AS is_bot_team
FROM hok.battle_power_players AS participant
JOIN hok.battle_power AS power ON power.game_seq = participant.game_seq
WHERE participant.side IN ('my','op')
GROUP BY participant.game_seq, participant.side, power.my_side_level, power.opponent_side_level
chat_power_activity:
SELECT player_key, game_seq, game_time_epoch, record_source,
       LAG(game_time_epoch) OVER (PARTITION BY player_key ORDER BY game_time_epoch, game_seq) AS previous_game_time_epoch,
       LAG(record_source) OVER (PARTITION BY player_key ORDER BY game_time_epoch, game_seq) AS previous_game_record_source
FROM hok.chat_player_battle_facts
WHERE game_time_epoch > 0
